subject.title: fix(skills): pass ownerHandle in ClawHub bulk verdict targets to resolve ambiguous slugs

question: Should this client PR wait for a confirmed ClawHub bulk-endpoint contract that resolves `ownerHandle`, or should OpenClaw instead implement an explicitly approved per-item owner-qualified verification fallback?
rationale: The required behavior crosses the OpenClaw client and the externally deployed ClawHub service; choosing a server rollout versus a client fallback determines the durable API and failure semantics.

options.title: Coordinate owner-aware bulk support
options.body: Implement and deploy the ClawHub bulk contract to consume `ownerHandle`, then validate this client propagation against the live endpoint.

options.title: Adopt a client fallback
options.body: Define and review an owner-qualified single-verify fallback for failed bulk items, including honest UI failure mapping and bounded request behavior.

recommendation.title: Coordinate owner-aware bulk support
recommendation.body: Implement and deploy the ClawHub bulk contract to consume `ownerHandle`, then validate this client propagation against the live endpoint.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the precise live contract evidence that identifies the cross-service decision boundary.
